statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heart rhythm consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73).
The patient reports symptoms of palpitations (R00.2).
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The service is ordered to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and optimize anticoagulation management.
The denial reason code is PR-204.
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan.
